why: The upstream row carries こちら's gloss verbatim — item こちら is "this person (polite); this way (polite)". あちら is the あ-series distal demonstrative (far from BOTH speaker and listener), the polite counterpart of あそこ/あっち. As shipped the card taught the opposite of what the word means. Cross-checked against そちら (near listener) and こちら (near speaker) in the same bank.
